title: Library Book Bundle Collection
description: A librarian wants to showcase book bundles for an upcoming fair. The available collection contains duplicate titles. Write a function to generate all unique subsets of book titles that can be formed from the collection.
constraints: The input list may contain duplicate book titles.
The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets.
input_format: A list of strings representing book titles, potentially containing duplicates.
output_format: A list of lists containing all unique subsets of the book titles.

examples.explanation: All unique subsets derived from the collection without repeating identical bundle combinations.
Distinct books yield standard power set combinations.
A single book yields the empty set and the single-element set.
